narrative.overview: Warm paper, deep palm green, editorial serif headings and real property photography establish a relaxed, welcoming resort identity. Comfortable spacing gives photographs room while rates, capacities and enquiry controls remain easy to scan. Documentation was extracted from implemented CSS. Mobbin required a paid plan; the Impeccable context/concept engine was unavailable. No generated concept image or screenshot is claimed as evidence.
keyCharacteristics: Serif headings and clear sans-serif information

rules.name: The Photo First Rule
rules.body: Keep visual emphasis on the real property and useful information; use the restrained palette around photographs.

dos: Do reuse the extracted palette, serif/sans pairing and corner language.
Do preserve visible focus, readable phone inputs and safe-area spacing.
Do keep room prices and capacities legible when layouts collapse.
donts: Don't fabricate reviews, amenities or availability.
Don't add raised containers around every content group.
Don't claim unavailable research or generated visual concepts as completed evidence.
